top_signals.title: New Inception extortion gang launches large-scale vishing campaign
top_signals.summary: A newly formed data extortion group named 'Inception' has been linked to a large-scale campaign that targets single sign-on (SSO) credentials of multiple global brands and firms. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Commission sets out key EU policy priorities for 2027 in its European Semester Autumn Package
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Strasbourg, 24 Nov 2026 The European Commission today adopted the 2027 European Semester Autumn Package, setting out economic, social and employment policy priorities.
